art_note: The imagery features flat composite mockups and marketplace-style sizing charts that detract from a luxury aesthetic.
desc_en: This crew neck sleeveless dress presents a sophisticated silhouette designed for the modern woman. Crafted from high-quality polyester with a subtle texture offering softness and comfort. The fitted waist enhances the natural shape with elegance. A versatile piece ideal for various casual and semi-formal occasions. Each piece is made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Este vestido sin mangas de cuello redondo presenta una silueta sofisticada diseñada para la mujer moderna. Confeccionado en poliéster de alta calidad con una textura sutil que aporta suavidad y comodidad. La cintura entallada realza la forma natural con elegancia. Una prenda versátil ideal para diversas ocasiones casuales y semiformales. Cada pieza se confecciona bajo pedido con envíos a todo el mundo.
details_en:
